articles.summary: The Current State of Labor Shortages in U.S. Manufacturing The American Manufacturing sector is grappling with a severe labor shortage that threatens to undermine its growth and competitiveness. By 2030, the manufacturing skills gap could result in 2.1 million unfilled jobs , potentially costing the industry $1 trillion in 2030 alone.
articles.title: Overcoming Labor Shortages with AGVs and AMRs
